subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept waited A2A reply extraction stopping at transcript-only OpenClaw rows, message-tool mirrors, and inter-session rows for source-reply handoffs before merge?
rationale: The code path is focused and covered, but it deliberately changes which transcript rows can drive visible channel replies, and CI cannot prove every live channel history shape.

options.title: Accept The Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the PR targets the observed duplicate visible-message subtype and keeps adjacent A2A problems separate.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel run if deterministic QA proof is not enough for this delivery path.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Coordination
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want message-tool mirror, reverse sessions_send, requester return-path, and compaction duplicate fixes coordinated together.

recommendation.title: Accept The Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the PR targets the observed duplicate visible-message subtype and keeps adjacent A2A problems separate.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the closest recent transcript-artifact identity change that this PR builds on.
